article_title: Why caffeine makes some people buzz - and others barely notice

tasks.correct_answer: Differences in metabolism, medicines, habits and tolerance influence its effects
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה שילוב של גנטיקה, פירוק בכבד, תרופות, עישון וסבילות כהסבר להבדלים.
options: Differences in metabolism, medicines, habits and tolerance influence its effects
The amount of coffee sold in a country determines sensitivity
Caffeine creates extra energy only in younger people

tasks.prompt: What best explains why caffeine affects people differently?

tasks.correct_answer: It blocks the action of adenosine in the brain
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קפאין חוסם את פעולת האדנוזין, חומר שמצטבר במוח וגורם לתחושת ישנוניות; הוא אינו מספק אנרגיה נוספת.
options: It immediately removes all adenosine from the body
It blocks the action of adenosine in the brain
It supplies the body with additional energy
It prevents the liver from producing enzymes
tasks.prompt: How does caffeine reduce the feeling of tiredness?

tasks.correct_answer: Broken down by the body's chemical processes

options: Converted directly into sleep
Absorbed only through the skin
Broken down by the body's chemical processes
Stored permanently in the brain
tasks.prompt: What does “metabolised” mean when the article describes caffeine in the liver?

tasks.correct_answer: Push the combined caffeine effect far enough to cause anxiety

options: Change the person's body weight immediately
Make the first cup leave the body faster
Measure the precise caffeine dose on a balance
Push the combined caffeine effect far enough to cause anxiety

tasks.correct_answer: Smoking can accelerate caffeine breakdown, so quitting may slow it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עישון עשוי לזרז פירוק קפאין בכבד. לאחר הפסקתו אותה כמות עשויה להישאר בגוף זמן רב יותר.
options: Smoking can accelerate caffeine breakdown, so quitting may slow it
Quitting permanently eliminates caffeine tolerance
Coffee beans contain more caffeine when a smoker quits
Vaping is proven to break down caffeine faster than smoking
tasks.prompt: Why might someone's usual coffee feel stronger after they stop smoking?

tasks.correct_answer: A rigid rule applied to everyone without considering individual differences
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זהו כלל גורף ונוקשה; המומחית מסבירה שהוא אינו מתחשב בהבדלים בין אנשים.
options: A method for measuring the quality of sleep
A rigid rule applied to everyone without considering individual differences
A recommendation limited to people using blankets
A rule that changes according to each person's metabolism
tasks.prompt: What does “a blanket hard-and-fast rule” mean in the sleep expert's discussion?
